label: lem:topological-mass-cat-transient
title: Transient terms localise to blow-up centres (categorical)
html:
The transient component \alpha - \hat{\tau}_n(\alpha) \in \mathcal{A}_{n+1}^{\mathrm{trans}} has support contained in the union of the kernels of \mathfrak{d}_{n+1} at the blow-up centres p_1, \ldots, p_N. The transient trace decomposes as a sum of disjoint local contributions:

  \mathrm{tr}(\alpha - \hat{\tau}_n(\alpha))
  = 
  \sum_{i=1}^{N} \mathrm{tr}_{\mathrm{trans}}(\varrho, p_i).
heading: Lemma
